scope: Known-case development of paid distinguishing-trajectory evidence, not a new formal cohort.
input_mismatch_note: Input-only denotes an untested endpoint in the learned input representation, not a hidden physical instrument parameter change. Both arms get identical actual paid calibration and fixed source hypothesis within each case.

source_acquisition.relation_only_boundary_rows: dynamic: previously unobserved cuts from fitted input expressions
source_acquisition.coefficient_source: Measured source transition or equivalent paid linear response fit; never read the private apparatus coupling.
source_acquisition.given_source_family: Existing total + .7 event(relation flow), window3 relational family; radius .8 is the supplied source parameter. This finite source family is explicit controlled-study prior, not claimed as independently discovered here.

cost_contract: Count all source acquisition/model fit, first command response, repeated fine acquisition, fresh validation, unsuccessful revisions, and relation research. Shared source work is recorded once and distinguished from per-case work; terminal is separate.
continuation: Both arms call the existing response research and RelationIntervalResearch with paid active probes to precision1e-6 or the same overall budget. The revised arm additionally invokes the actual production diagnose_relation_inputs helper before relation conclusions consume a selected-law counterexample.
protocol_revision: Same final v2 controlled-development protocol; both arms pure-relation controls pay all cuts visible in their source input models. No algorithm, budget or seed changes after frozen confirmation starts.

seed_generation.algorithm: random.Random(202609148401).randrange(10000000000,99999999999), reject prior protocol/config seeds and repeats

evaluation_gate: All72case learning results (two arms x12apparatus x3cases) complete before terminal evaluation.
